text: 此人不能告诉你什么。
source_text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

text: You see two super mutants. One looks hurt, and the other is tending him.
source_text: You see two super mutants. One looks hurt, and the other is tending him.

text: Well, how do you feel now?
source_text: Well, how do you feel now?

text: 【moves his shoulder】 Ah, it's still a little sore. At least the bleeding stopped.
source_text: 【moves his shoulder】 Ah, it's still a little sore. At least the bleeding stopped.

text: Good, good. Keep using your medication and you should be good as new.
source_text: Good, good. Keep using your medication and you should be good as new.

text: Excellent. When I get my hands on that little human, I'm going to crush him.
source_text: Excellent. When I get my hands on that little human, I'm going to crush him.

text: Excellent. When I get my hands on that little human, I'm going to crush her.
source_text: Excellent. When I get my hands on that little human, I'm going to crush her.

text: He sure did enough damage that last time. I hope they get him soon.
source_text: He sure did enough damage that last time. I hope they get him soon.

text: She did enough damage that last time. I hope they get her soon.
source_text: She did enough damage that last time. I hope they get her soon.

text: Imagine if all of our plans were ruined because of one little human.
source_text: Imagine if all of our plans were ruined because of one little human.

text: 【laughs】 Yeah, that would be a shame.
source_text: 【laughs】 Yeah, that would be a shame.

text: 【chuckles】
source_text: 【chuckles】

text: 你看到两个超级变种人，其中一个受伤了，另一个搀扶着他。
source_text: 你看到两个超级变种人，其中一个受伤了，另一个搀扶着他。

text: 嗯，你现在感觉怎么样？
source_text: 嗯，你现在感觉怎么样？

text: 【动动肩膀】嗯，还有点疼，至少止血了。
source_text: 【动动肩膀】嗯，还有点疼，至少止血了。

text: 好，不错，接着吃药，不多久你就会鲜蹦乱跳的了。
source_text: 好，不错，接着吃药，不多久你就会鲜蹦乱跳的了。

text: 很好，如果让我抓到那个渺小的人类，我会捏碎他。
source_text: 很好，如果让我抓到那个渺小的人类，我会捏碎他。

text: 很好，如果让我抓到那个渺小的人类，我会捏碎她。
source_text: 很好，如果让我抓到那个渺小的人类，我会捏碎她。

text: 他打得我很爽，我希望他们很快就能抓到他。
source_text: 他打得我很爽，我希望他们很快就能抓到他。

text: 她打得我很爽，我希望他们很快就能抓到她。
source_text: 她打得我很爽，我希望他们很快就能抓到她。

text: 想象一下，如果我们的全盘计划都毁灭了，而只是因为一个渺小的人类。
source_text: 想象一下，如果我们的全盘计划都毁灭了，而只是因为一个渺小的人类。

text: 【大笑】是啊，那真是丢人啊。
source_text: 【大笑】是啊，那真是丢人啊。

text: 【偷着笑】
source_text: 【偷着笑】
